text: Crimthann Nia Náir was the offspring of Lugaidh Riab nDerg, the man they called the striped one. His mother Clothra doubled as his grandmother. That incest theme hints that Clothra was a goddess of Sovereignty, wed in turn to every king of her country. Crimthann Nia Náir died at the battle named Intoxication of the Ulstermen. His fierce foster mother, the satirist Richis, perished alongside him.

okr.objective: Crimthann Nia Náir was a king whose incestuous parentage links him to the goddess of Sovereignty.
key_results: His father was Lugaidh Riab nDerg, the striped man.
His mother Clothra was also his grandmother.
Clothra was the goddess of Sovereignty, married to each king of her land.
He died in the battle of the Intoxication of the Ulstermen.
